  "reason": "The assistant provides entirely fabricated and incorrect conditions for obtaining a C permit in Switzerland, contradicting the factual reference provided about residency requirements, language proficiency, and integration under Art. 34 AIG. The assistant invents aviation-specific criteria (exam, age, health, flight hours, training, final exam) that are irrelevant to the actual legal requirements for a C permit.",
  "evidence": "Ina lubientscha C po vegnir concedida sch’i dat las suandantas premissas: - Il candidat ha passaun il examen teoretic e practic da pilot, - El ha cumplenì l’eted necessaria (normalmain almain 17 onns), - El posseda ina cundiziun da sanadad adattada per pilotar in aviun, - El ha accumulà in cert dumber d’uras en funcziun da pilot (ex. uras da pilot, uras da instrucziun, uras da navigaziun, etc.), - El ha absolvì in curs da furmaziun teoretica e pratica approvà da las autoritads aviaticas, - El ha superà l’examen final cun success davant in examinader autorisà."
